name: Let's Relax Spa Phuket (Patong)
nameZh: 乐放松水疗·普吉巴东店
tagline: Thailand's most trusted spa chain, steps from Patong Beach
taglineZh: 泰国最知名连锁水疗品牌，巴东海滩近在咫尺
description: Let's Relax Spa is one of Thailand's best-known day spa chains with multiple award-winning branches. The Patong branch offers traditional Thai massage, aromatherapy and signature packages in a calm, professional environment just minutes from Patong Beach.
descriptionZh: Let's Relax Spa 是泰国最著名的连锁水疗品牌之一，多次获奖。巴东店位于巴东海滩附近，提供泰式传统按摩、香薰理疗与招牌套餐，环境安静、手法专业。

location.address: 27/96 Rat-U-Thit 200 Pee Rd, Patong, Kathu, Phuket 83150

name: Makkha Health & Spa Phuket
tagline: Authentic Lanna-style healing in the heart of Phuket Town
taglineZh: 普吉镇中心的正宗兰纳式泰式疗愈
description: Makkha Health & Spa brings traditional northern Thai (Lanna) healing techniques to Phuket. Known for skilled therapists and a heritage-house atmosphere, it is a favourite for travellers seeking authentic Thai massage away from the beach crowds.
descriptionZh: Makkha Health & Spa 将泰北兰纳传统理疗技法带到普吉。治疗师手法地道，老宅改建的店铺别有韵味，是远离海滩人潮、体验正宗泰式按摩的好去处。

name: Spring Massage Phuket
tagline: Highly-rated oil and deep tissue massage in Patong
taglineZh: 巴东高评分精油与深层组织按摩
description: Spring Massage is a well-reviewed massage house in Patong known for strong, skilled therapists and clean private rooms. Popular with Chinese-speaking travellers, the staff offers bilingual menus covering oil massage, deep tissue and foot reflexology.
descriptionZh: Spring Massage 位于巴东，口碑出众，治疗师手法有力娴熟，包间干净整洁。备有中英双语价目表，深受华语游客欢迎，主打精油按摩、深层组织与足底按摩。

location.address: Rat-U-Thit 200 Pee Rd, Patong, Kathu, Phuket 83150
